question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a brown ball, Dave has a teal ball, Eve has a gold ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Finally, Bob and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) pink ball
(C) brown ball
(D) teal ball
(E) gold ball
(F) green ball
(G) grey ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: white, pink, brown, teal, gold, green, grey
1. Fred ↔ Alice: green, pink, brown, teal, gold, white, grey
2. Gertrude ↔ Claire: green, pink, grey, teal, gold, white, brown
3. Bob ↔ Dave: green, teal, grey, pink, gold, white, brown
4. Bob ↔ Claire: green, grey, teal, pink, gold, white, brown
5. Dave ↔ Bob: green, pink, teal, grey, gold, white, brown
6. Claire ↔ Fred: green, pink, white, grey, gold, teal, brown
7. Bob ↔ Alice: pink, green, white, grey, gold, teal, brown
Fred has the teal ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
